opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, as the scorecard requires.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and the order number or postcode?
verification.comment: You asked for the full name and postcode before discussing the payment, and the caller gave both.

understanding.quote: So you've disputed that payment with your bank and want to know the next step?
understanding.comment: You captured the issue accurately and did not re-ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I'll email you today to confirm the note on your order.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The statements were not wrong, but you gave no timeline for the Payments team and did not mention that disputes are handled by Payments within 2 working days.

process_compliance.quote: Yes, you wait for your bank.
process_compliance.comment: The policy requires passing bank disputes to the Payments team, who reply within 2 working days; you should have escalated the case to Payments rather than telling the caller to wait.

communication.quote: I'm sorry you had to go to your bank over this.
communication.comment: You were polite and apologetic throughout, and the caller did not express frustration beyond a neutral request.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the follow-up email and asked if there was anything else before closing politely.
